desc:
🏃‍♂️💨 Sprint, level up & become the UNSTOPPABLE Ultimate Christmas Speed Runner! 🎄🔥
Race across candy cane keyboards, dodge insane hazards, and stack massive multipliers to dominate the leaderboard!
🔥 How to play:
🏃 Run & jump through brutal stages
🍫 Survive chocolate pits, crushers, fading platforms, a gingerbread man and a yeti
💤 Train AFK on treadmills while you're away
💰 Stack up multiple bonuses
🔁 Rebirth up to R8 for permanent rewards
🎁 Hatch Christmas pets from the Pet Egg and the Golden Egg
💎 Features:
⭐ Powerful upgrades & rebirth system
⭐ Stunning auras and glowing trails
⭐ Roblox Plus gives +50% EXP Boost!
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and become a LEGEND!
🔑 Tags: Parkour, Obby, Race, Simulator, AFK, Rebirth, Boss, Multiplayer, Leaderboard, Upgrades, Auras, Trails, Pets, Christmas, Ultimate Speed Runner
